accepted_statement: For every rank-(m-2) physical shield P with arbitrary Boolean core, every finite adaptive/pruned restriction tree querying only P coordinates, and every one common arbitrary disjoint Boolean terminal factor h, the retained loss U(Ph)-sum_l w_l U(P_l h) is at most 2I(P), uniformly in all parameters.
scope_exclusions: leaf-dependent or newly introduced terminal cores
cores sharing variables with the shield
nodewise reissuance of the coefficient-two certificate
